text:
sophia: quick idea — can we tighten the postmortem follow-up loop? i've seen a couple of long-running remediation items slip. proposing a 2-step cadence + single owner per action. thoughts?

mike: sounds sensible. do you mean a weekly check-in or something more automated? :thinking_face: 

sophia: both. weekly human check-ins + an automated reminder + public tracker. low friction so it doesn't become another doc nobody updates.

laura: agree. our current tracker lives in the pm notes and is hard to query. would prefer a lightweight CSV/issue-backed table.

james: +1. curious about SLAs — what's the target for P1/P2/P3?

ada: (from oncall) historically we left a lot open for "ops review" which is vague. having concrete timelines will help incident commanders when they close.

sophia: draft SLA proposal: P1 = acknowledge + owner assigned within 4h, remediation plan within 24-72h; P2 = owner within 24h, plan within 3 business days; P3 = owner within 7 days. escalate if overdue. open to tweaks.

mike: fine with that. also want a rolling 90-day look for recurring patterns (if same subsystem triggers 3+ incidents in 90d, we schedule a dedicated reliability project).

laura: can we make the tracker include a "recurrence bucket" field so it's easy to query for that?

james: here's a tiny tracker template I mocked — copy into #docs once we agree: 

```
Owner | Action | Incident | Priority | Due | Status | Next check-in
---|---|---|---|---|---|---
@owner-name | Rotate failing nodegroup | INC-2029 | P1 | 2027-06-20 | In progress | 2027-06-18 weekly
@backend-oncall | Add circuit breaker | INC-2041 | P2 | 2027-07-02 | Open | 2027-06-25
```

sophia: +1 to GH issue integration. If we create an "incident-remediation" label and require a linked issue for every action, we can query and backfill.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled — will ping owners 48h before due date and on overdue.

ada: for communication cadence, propose:
- at incident close: create tracker entries + assign owners
- 48h post-close: owner confirms POA or moves to internal backlog
- weekly triage meeting: 15min to sweep overdue/high-impact items
- 30/60/90 day follow-ups for pattern detection

mike: who rotates the incident commander (IC) for follow-ups? currently ICs change per incident but not for the follow-up lifecycle. maybe a "remediation lead" rotation separate from oncall?

sophia: yes — suggestion: designate the original IC as remediation lead for 7 days, then hand off to a rotation pool if still open. rotation pool volunteers (2 people) pick up longer-running items. prevents orphaned postmortem actions.

laura: ok, but need guardrails: handoff note + updated due dates + 'why' summary. otherwise context gets lost.

james: agree. also add a short template for handoff message: 
```
Handoff: reason, work done so far, next steps, blockers, estimated time.
```

sophia: next steps: (1) laura to prototype a CSV + GH label integration (2) james to add template to docs (3) mike to coordinate rotation pool volunteers — aim to ship by EOW. i'll create the follow-up board and invite owners.

laura: i'll start the prototype tonight, will post link here when ready.

mike: i'll ping the ops channel for volunteers.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Created follow-up board draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/incidents/boards/5 — check it out.

sophia: awesome, thanks everyone. if you have objections to the SLA numbers, say now, otherwise i'll update the incident process doc and ping for the EOW ship. :thumbsup:
